metadata.purpose: Collect inner sources until the outer completes; then subscribe and emit fresh arrays whenever an inner updates after all first values arrive.

conditions: The outer emits inner Observable identities; no inner is subscribed until outer completion.
After outer completion, with n nonempty sources, no output is permitted until every inner has emitted at least once.
Thereafter each inner next emits a fresh n-element latest-value array in outer-source order; completion waits for every inner to complete.
An empty outer completes with no next. Any inner errors terminate immediately.

scope.parameters: Observable-valued outer source, nonempty or empty; no optional projector.
scope.callbacks: No user callback for this profile; projector overload must be specified/tested separately and is not claimed here.
scope.time: No internal timer. Collection barrier is outer completion; subsequent ordering is determined by inner notifications, including equal-time arrival order.
scope.reentrancy: Inner notifications delivered after all initial inner subscriptions have been installed; arbitrary synchronous emissions during that setup excluded.
exclusions: Optional project function, arbitrary ObservableInput/Promise conversion and synchronous/reentrant emission during inner subscription setup.
Observer/finalizer throw, cancellation inside output delivery, outer observable reference mutation and universal symbolic equivalence.
No early completion when an inner completes without a value: pinned RxJS combineLatestInit waits for every inner completion.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Connect outer only, retain inner-source tokens, subscribe to all collected inners only after outer completion.

ownership.sharing: No sharing. One execution holds source collection and one subscription per collected inner.
ownership.reset: Each subscription starts without latest values. Ready flags distinguish not-yet-emitted from a real undefined value.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Collect while outer is live, then connect inners in order; each latest notification replaces one slot and emits only when every slot is ready.
cancellationCheckpoints: Explicit cancellation disposes live sources without completion or pending value output.
Source completion and inner completion are separate; no scheduler or sharing is implied.
